L: Hey everyone, welcome back to my little kitchen!
Today I'm trying to bake bread for the very first time.
I've watched tons of videos, so I think I know what to do.
First, I mix the flour, yeast and a bit of warm water.
Then I knead the dough for about ten minutes.
Honestly, my arms are already getting tired!
While the dough is rising, I'll clean up this mess.
I just hope it doesn't turn out like a rock.
Wish me luck, and I'll show you the result soon!
